decisions.rationale: 'alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma' names one specific disease (a defined rhabdomyosarcoma subtype) with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.

'solid tumors' refers to a family of multiple pathologically disparate diseases rather than one specific disease, so it is a Disease Class. 'tumors' is retained per the rule that 'tumor' is not excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions (Disease Class); 11. Grey area terms annotated as Disease Class if appropriate; Do Not Annotate 4 (cancer and tumor retained)

'tumor' is used as a modifier of the noun phrase 'tumor cells' (the cells of the tumor), so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than as a standalone disease mention.
